notes: Assumes the response body is JSON with a top-level card field.
mule:
<ee:transform>
  <ee:message>
    <ee:set-payload><![CDATA[%dw 2.0
output application/json
---
payload update {
  case card at .card -> "**** **** **** " ++ ((card as String)[-4 to -1] default "")
}]]></ee:set-payload>
  </ee:message>
</ee:transform>
